messages:
Eli: seeing weird behavior this morning — some premium tenants suddenly getting repeated 503s. tracing shows same request id bouncing eu-west <-> us-east and toggling model_variant between `gptx-q4` and `gptx-q8` every hop. :eyes:
Rina: ugh, that looks like a routing oscillation. any recent rollout or policy change?
Eli: I didn't touch tier routing. console change log shows a small canary to `fallback_policy: cascade` for the tiered-routing feature around 06:12 UTC. DeployBot: canary rollout started: rollout_id=rl-3321, target=eng-platform,tier=A, 06:12:05 UTC.
Jorge: cascade fallback + zero cooldown can cause flip-flop if capacity checks race. if eu-west says "insufficient" then request falls to us-east, which then triggers a quick capacity recompute back in eu-west, which returns OK, so next requests get routed back. repeat.
Maya: confirming, infra metrics show ephemeral capacity estimates oscillating for the GPU pool (vm flapping due to autoscaler sampling). autoscaler logs: `scale_decision: up->down->up within 30s window` — bad alignment with our fallback cooldown.
Sam: also noticed quotas for these tenants hit burst window at minute boundaries; quota reset triggers immediate re-evaluation of routing eligibility. combined with cascade fallback that has no sticky TTL = recipe for oscillation.
Eli: attaching a snippet of the problematic policy we rolled:```json
{
  "route_policy": {
    "prefer_region": "auto",
    "fallback_policy": "cascade",
    "fallback_ttl_ms": 0,
    "max_hops": 3
  }
}
```
Rina: fallback_ttl_ms=0 is the smoking gun. set a short cooldown so a failed region stays quarantined for a bit. propose 60_000ms initially. Also consider `fallback_sticky\": true` for tier-A.
Jorge: agreed. immediate mitigation steps I suggest: 1) patch rollout to revert cascade -> prefer_local 2) set fallback_ttl_ms=60000 3) enable per-tenant sticky routing. I can push a hotfix to the policy service.
Maya: I'll pause autoscaler aggressiveness for the gpu-pool serving eu-west to avoid transient up/down thrash while we stabilize.
Eli: Rina, Jorge — can you also disable the canary rollout? DeployBot: canary rl-3321 paused by DeployBot at 06:26:13 UTC (operator request).
Jorge: pushing policy patch now: `rwdctl routes update --tenant-tier A --set fallback_ttl_ms=60000 --set fallback_policy=prefer_local`
ConsoleBot: route policy update accepted, change_id=chg-8803, applying to tier A (propagating to routers).
Rina: added a short-term circuit-breaker on model-variant fallback: if the same request id experiences >2 cross-region hops within 30s, abort and return a soft-failure (503 with onboarding hint) to avoid infinite loops. I'll file the change: CHG-8804.
Eli: logs after patch show immediate drop in multi-hop traces. sample: `trace_id=abc123 hops=[eu-west->us-east]` vs previous `hops=[eu-west->us-east->eu-west->us-east]`. success rate for affected tenants up from 78% -> 98% in 10m window. :thumbsup:
Sam: adding dashboard tiles: 1) per-tier multi-hop rate 2) fallback_ttl hit/miss 3) per-region capacity-flap counter. opening a quick panel in Console -> Observability -> Tiles.
Maya: FYI autoscaler throttling change rolled in eu-west pool: min_stable_window=120s (was 30s). should reduce oscillation.
Eli: follow-ups: - schedule postmortem, include rollout gating checks - add unit/integration tests for routing decisions under racey capacity signals - telemetry: emit `routing_decision_reason` tag (capacity/quota/policy) in traces so we can filter quickly
Rina: I'll own the postmortem. Drafting doc and will ping eng-platform + eng-sre.
Jorge: next week we should iterate on a safer default: `fallback_policy: prefer_local` + `fallback_ttl_ms=30000` for all tiers, and a config flag to allow cascade only for experimental tenants.
Eli: thanks everyone. good catch on the canary scope — we'll revisit canary gating rules. closing thread once postmortem link is up.
DeployBot: canary rl-3321 marked paused and config rolled back to rl-3319.
ConsoleBot: dashboard panel saved: "Tier A multi-hop rate" (link: https://console.example/reports/panels/782)
Rina: postmortem created: https://confluence.example/redwood/pm/routing-oscillation-1790456789 — will add timeline + action items.
Eli: great. moving to monitoring watch for the next 24h. :fire_engine:
